correctness.rationale: Every X with X²=N square-zero has X^4=0, giving exactly Jordan block sizes 1..4; squaring yields the two equations and root rank. Finite-field nilpotent GL-conjugacy orbit sizes are group order divided by the exact unit-centralizer size q^D product U. Equivariance of squaring proves each fixed target class fiber coefficient equals Z(N)/Z(X); this is an integer. Explicit choices of a,b,c cover and bound precisely every asserted root rank. Direct independently coded matrix-power/rank enumeration over F2,F3,F4 for n<=3 and F2 for n=4 agrees with all target ranks, and symbolic coefficient/boundary sweeps n<=15 passed. The computations are corroboration, not a substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: Power-map fibers are intrinsic invariants of finite matrix algebras. This complete rank-refined enumeration counts actual roots of each fixed nonzero square-zero matrix for every n and q, not merely allowable Jordan types; exact positive multiplicities, emptiness, and a gap-free rank interval expose meaningful arithmetic structure. Its precise fixed-target refinement is not a known table recomputation and can serve as finite-field data for nilpotent-root varieties and representation-counting questions.
